basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has published the Assistant Professor Grade II Notification 2026 under Advertisement No. NITR/ES/2026/M/2323. The recruitment drive aims to fill Assistant Professor Grade II positions. Candidates holding a First Class B.Tech./B.E., B.Des., M.Arch., M.Plan., MBA, M.Tech., M.Sc., LLM, or equivalent qualification along with a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline are eligible to apply online through https://www.nitrkl.ac.in/. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Rourkela to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post at NIT Rourkela is 03 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NIT Rourkela Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post will receive a salary as per Pay Level-11.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications include a First Class in B.Tech./B.E. with Ph.D. or equivalent degrees in relevant disciplines, depending on the specific branch.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.
